title: Stacked Forces Effect
hook: One tactic on its own barely moves anything. Stack a few together and the results get wild.
statement: When several psychological forces push the same way, the result is way bigger than any one alone.
explainer: Scarcity, social proof, and authority are each mild on their own. Combine them in one push and they multiply. That's how viral hits happen, and how pile-up disasters happen too.
sop: List the psychological forces behind your customer's decision.
Pick the ones you can stack honestly.
Combine them in one coordinated launch.
Measure the combined result, not each piece.
Break down competitors' big wins the same way.
equation_example: Score each force 1 to 10. Scarcity 6, Social Proof 8, Authority 5. Multiply them: 6 × 8 × 5 = 240. Just adding gets you 19. Higher means the forces are compounding. One weak force drags the whole stack down.
question: Name three forces you could stack in your next launch, and score each one honestly.
closing_statement: A stack of small forces can outweigh one big one.
caption:
Principle Nº 314: Stacked Forces Effect

One tactic on its own barely moves anything. Stack a few together and the results get wild.

When several psychological forces push the same way, the result is way bigger than any one alone.

Your turn: Name three forces you could stack in your next launch, and score each one honestly.
